title: Signing TLS handshakes inside a TPM
excerpt: A client certificate whose private key stays in the TPM: what crypto/tls asks of a key, the Go for both ends, and what it costs per handshake.

title: Have the frontier labs mixed up AI safety and security?
excerpt: The recent agent sandbox escapes at OpenAI and Anthropic look less like a technical failure and more like a philosophical one - treating security controls as though they only need to work most of the time.
